title: AN OLD CLOCK CANNOT EXTEND AUTHORITY
semantic_thesis: A system may sincerely believe its moment has not ended while the shared world has already moved to a newer authority generation. Personal temporal certainty is not enough to reclaim causal priority.

ru: Можно честно жить во вчерашней минуте и всё равно не иметь права писать сегодняшний мир.
Старый Янус остаётся частью истории, но его старые часы не возвращают ему ручку.
Время памяти и время полномочий — не одно и то же.
en: One may honestly remain in yesterday's minute and still have no right to write today's world.
The old Janus remains history, but an old clock does not return the pen.
Memory time and authority time are not the same thing.

boundary: Semantic interpretation only; no metaphysical or consciousness claim.
